# automox_scheduled_windows (Data Source)

Maintenance windows in the configured organization.

Windows are scoped by organization UUID and identify server groups by UUID, where the rest of the API uses integer IDs; the provider resolves that for you.

No filter arguments are offered because the search endpoint has none: it accepts a request body but ignores any filter in it, so a filter here would look like it worked while returning everything.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `scheduled_windows` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled_windows))

<a id="nestedatt--scheduled_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scheduled_windows`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `dtstart` (String)
- `duration_minutes` (Number) Unset on `ONCE` windows, where Automox derives it.
- `group_uuids` (List of String) UUIDs of the server groups this window covers.
- `org_uuid` (String)
- `recurrence` (String) `ONCE` or `RECURRING`.
- `rrule` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `use_local_tz` (Boolean)
- `window_description` (String)
- `window_name` (String)
- `window_type` (String) `exclude` — the only value Automox accepts.
- `window_uuid` (String) Windows are identified by UUID; Automox issues no integer ID.
